scope: Remaining Item 20 analytical performance work in PR #1619
trigger: The maintainer rejected the automatic percentage cutoff after a complete positive-gain candidate had been dropped, directed that it be implemented, requested an audit of similar historical drops, and clarified that small gains compound.

performance_rule.ship: candidate complete-cohort engine seconds < accepted baseline complete-cohort engine seconds
performance_rule.drop: candidate complete-cohort engine seconds >= accepted baseline complete-cohort engine seconds
performance_rule.clock: sum of engine_execution_seconds for one execution of each of the unchanged 347 cases

unchanged_requirements: Resource, ownership, cancellation and no-fallback contracts
Isolated sequential execution and frozen source/input/runtime identities
Preserve every original observation and regression flag
No baseline rerun or repeated trials solely to change a decision
historical_policy: Preserve historical prospective protocols and original threshold results. Apply the new maintainer decision as a separately linked disposition; do not relabel an original threshold failure as a threshold pass.
compounding_policy: Advance the accepted baseline with each retained improvement. Audit earlier positive-gain drops and integrate applicable source changes with current correctness and combined-performance checks; historical deltas are not additive evidence for the current implementation.

immediate_candidate.candidate: Grouped integer extrema and optional COUNT traversal
immediate_candidate.source_restoration: All six candidate source files restored byte-for-byte to the measured snapshot; no measurement rerun
immediate_candidate.remaining_acceptance: Complete broad source gates and combined Item 20 acceptance
